intro: Westchester sits on the bluffs just north of LAX, home to Loyola Marymount University and a set of neighborhood restaurants and coffee shops along Manchester Avenue, La Tijera Boulevard and the Westchester Triangle.

to: Time Out: The best restaurants in LA
gm: Google Maps reviews (local favorites we checked)

places.w: A coffee roaster with a roomy cafe, good wifi and easy parking, popular for working.
places.o: A flat white with a pastry.

places.w: A busy corner cafe minutes from LAX with a long breakfast menu and house-made biscuits.
places.o: An omelet with the Potatoes O'Brien and a biscuit.

places.w: A seasonal, garden-to-table restaurant and bakery with a rooftop patio that looks out on planes landing at LAX.
places.o: Morning pastries, or dinner on the roof.

places.w: A family-owned Thai restaurant that has been a Westside favorite since 2004.
places.o: Chicken satay, pad see ew and mango sticky rice. Book ahead; it fills up.

places.w: A newer Japanese restaurant known for handmade udon and katsu sets.
